description: Sparse matrices (CsMatrix products, sums, triangular solves, CsCholesky on SPD graph Laplacians) against upstream's dense forms, and vector convolutions

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: cs_mul_lap1d8
ops.doc: a * b (CsMatrix): two 8x8 tridiagonal patterns, a pentadiagonal product
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: cs_mul_rect
ops.doc: a * b (CsMatrix): a 5x7 pattern of 12 entries times a 7x4 pattern of 10 entries
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: cs_add_lap2d9
ops.doc: a + b (CsMatrix): a 3x3-grid 2D-Laplacian pattern plus a 9x9 tridiagonal one
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: cs_solve_lower_lap2d9
ops.doc: l.solve_lower_triangular(&b) (CsMatrix) (L: the lower 2D-Laplacian pattern of a 3x3 grid, entries of an SPD a)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 18 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cs_tr_solve_lower_lap2d9
ops.doc: l.tr_solve_lower_triangular(&b) (CsMatrix) (L: the lower 2D-Laplacian pattern of a 3x3 grid, entries of an SPD a)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 18 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cs_solve_lower_cs_lap2d9
ops.doc: l.solve_lower_triangular_cs(&b) (CsMatrix, b sparse: its entries 0 and 4 only), as a dense vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 18 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cs_cholesky_lap1d16
ops.doc: CsCholesky::new(&a).l() on the SPD Laplacian of a 16-node pattern (15 edges); upstream's dense Cholesky of the same matrix, L row-major
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 64 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cs_cholesky_lap2d16
ops.doc: CsCholesky::new(&a).l() on the SPD Laplacian of a 16-node pattern (24 edges); upstream's dense Cholesky of the same matrix, L row-major
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 64 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cs_cholesky_lap2d9
ops.doc: CsCholesky::new(&a).l() on the SPD Laplacian of a 9-node pattern (12 edges); upstream's dense Cholesky of the same matrix, L row-major
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 36 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
